description.name: Virtutel NBN
description.tagline: Automated NBN provisioning via the Virtutel Customer API
description.long: Provisions, modifies and manages NBN services through the Virtutel Customer API, including service qualification, connect/churn orders, appointments, callback-driven status sync, and FreeRADIUS (IPoE) subscriber provisioning.
features: Service qualification by address or NBN Location ID
Connect, churn, modify and disconnect orders
FreeRADIUS IPoE provisioning keyed on AVC ID
